description:
Timestamped transcript of a TikTok video from its captions (auto-generated or creator-added), with the caption languages available. Pick a language with lang.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: video_id (string), language (string), is_auto_generated (boolean, nullable), available_languages (array<object>), segments (array<object>), text (string), segment_count (integer).

lang.description: Caption language: a code like en or es, or TikTok's code like eng-US. Defaults to the video's original language. Example: "en"

name: tiktok_transcript
title: TikTok video transcript
